customer_agreement_override.precedence_note: Local repository fixture; no external commercial service terms apply.

policy_review.rationale: Demonstrates a provider-neutral Work 0.1 capability manifest with zero cloud dependencies.

metered_costs.summary: No paid or metered external service is used.

customer_data_use.purpose: Deterministic offline conformance testing of Work 0.1 run ledgers.
customer_data_use.scope: Synthetic test fixtures inside a temporary directory only.
customer_data_use.evidence_requirement: Local command invocation by operator or CI runner.
customer_data_use.withdrawal_path: Stop invoking the local test runner; remove temporary test directory.

data_lifecycle.correction: Append correction event to a new local Work run.
data_lifecycle.restriction: Do not supply real customer or credential data to fixture tests.
data_lifecycle.retention: Deleted at end of test run; OS temp layer retention not separately guaranteed.
data_lifecycle.export: Plain JSON files readable without proprietary tools.
data_lifecycle.deletion: Remove local temp directory; filesystem wear-leveling layers remain outside handler scope.
data_lifecycle.abandonment: No background processes remain after process exit.
data_lifecycle.account_closure: Not applicable; no external account exists.

read.summary: Read one synthetic fixture record by ID without side effects.

authorization_requirements.provider_grant: Local filesystem read access to repository fixtures.
authorization_requirements.customer_data_permission: Not applicable to synthetic repository fixtures.
authorization_requirements.exact_execution_approval: Not required for read-only fixture lookup; required for any effectful operation.

execution_rules.idempotency_rule: Read-only local lookups are deterministic; writes remain disabled.

governance.audit_readiness: All inputs and outputs are deterministic local files.
